title: Fun At First
body: This game is fun at first. I really like the story and the characters. However, as with all merge games I’ve played, it devolves into repetitiveness. The various merge scenarios are interesting when they are new, but at some point it begins to feel like you’re going through the motions trying to achieve a goal that is simply unattainable without spending a certain amount of money. That is no fun. I prefer a game that charges you a modest fee up front, and then all the goals are attainable if you have the right amount of skill and patience. They either need to change things up, add puzzle elements to this game so that it’s not all merge, all the time (just not match three, for the love of God!) or accept that most people won’t stick around for long.

title: Gameplay stagnates very quickly
body: I want to love it. It’s cute and fun and the storyline seems well written. But after you get to level 18-19, gameplay stagnates. You’re stuck with 1-3 quests that all ask for the exact same very high level object. Normally this wouldn’t bother me, but the single generator for said object runs out before you’ve even spent half your energy. I’ve spent days and days crafting a single item, and if you can’t progress on your quests, you can’t participate in events. I want to love the game, but the later-stage grind is just too slow. I can’t even use the energy I am given, much less all the max level energy bonuses wasting space in my inventory.

title: Need method to trash generators
body: Love the game; love the story (and can’t wait for more), but there’s one small thing nagging at me. There are certain items that cannot be gotten rid of. There’s no trash can available when you click on the item. At first, it was just level 1 of the Platform. I was trying to get some max level generators for the Cauldron and the Oven, so I didn’t have room to be holding on to a lot of Platform pieces, as well. But there was no way to trash the item. Now, I made the mistake of merging Cauldron pieces from a chest instead of trashing each one individually. Level 2 and 3 Cauldrons apparently can be trashed, but I made a level 4 Cauldron (which is the first level at which it is a generator) by mistake. I cannot get rid of that extra Cauldron. So now I’m stuck with something taking up a board space that I neither want nor can get rid of. (It might also be nice if trashing unwanted items offered a wee bit of gold, but that’s much less irritating.)
